summary: Expose the existing Cart palette selector and color input, and apply palette-only changes through the current canonical bridge with readback and restoration checks.

scoped_evidence.affected_subsystem: Cart Owner PWA palette and color controls (Feature Tree B1.03).
scoped_evidence.observed_source_defect: The existing dynamic Matrix palette selector and color input were only inside the collapsed Saved looks and advanced color section, matching the documented owner-visible report that alternate palettes were missing from the iPad surface.
scoped_evidence.implementation: Move the existing palette selector and shared solid/text color input into a visible accessible panel. Add a separate palette-only action using the existing canonical PALETTE command, capability gate, current-state preflight, readback verification, and previous-palette restoration attempt on an unconfirmed result. No new protocol, service, dependency, or scoring behavior.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Revert this isolated source/test commit; no device, cloud, firmware, router, release, or score mutation is included.
